title: Volkswagen T1 Drag Bus
summary: When Volkswagen cataloged and coded factory two-tone paint combinations for these vehicles, the lower body colour was always listed first in the official factory colour sequence and documentation. n a two-tone 1960s Volkswagen Bus, the bottom colour is considered the primary or main body colour, while the lighter shade on top (the roof and window beltline) acts as the secondary accent colour.

title: Hot Wheels: Beat That!
summary: Hot Wheels: Beat That! is a racing video game released in September 2007 and based on the Hot Wheels toy line manufactured by Mattel. The game was developed by Eutechnyx and published by Activision.

title: Hot Wheels XL
summary: 200px|rightHot Wheels XL is a 1:43 scale series of Hot Wheels; in essence the castings in this series are scaled up versions of mainline castings, carrying over their decos and often their wheels. This series was developed by Charlie Angulo.

summary: Released in 2010, the Hot Wheels Garage succeeded the 2009 Larry's Garage line after Larry Wood retired from Mattel in 2009.
